description: A 1.0.0 document without integrity.signature whose integrity.hash was computed as 1.0.0 specifies it ("computed with this field empty": integrity.hash "", no signature member) runs (rc.8). The art_ is unchanged: SHA-256 with integrity.hash and integrity.signature "" (SPEC-2.0 §8.1); the kernel accepts either seal for such a document, and both cover the whole content. rc.7 refused it with code 3.
